functions.effects: Pure candidate data preparation; captures and selected evidence stage remain exact. No actual root authenticity or ownership grant.

functions.name: diagnose
functions.source_index: Zero based: authority is index 0, declarations follow, selections follow. A source refusal retains its complete original envelope and every earlier input passed preflight.
functions.numeric_token: Exact scalar parser number lexeme when numeric preflight refuses; not a rounded number or fabricated field path.
functions.limits: The three typed-data causes are stage-level. They do not identify the single failing field or assert authenticity, blame, authority or ownership.

representation: Retain original UInt8 bytes, numeric lexemes, duplicate object entries and original capture ordering. A decoded-value JSON schema cannot replace the exact raw-byte and lexical checks.
authentic_boundary: Every transition from prepared data to owned selection still requires actual RootPolicy.authoritativeSnapshot evidence under the exact root/frame/capture. No real provider is supplied.
implementation_limits: Legacy preparation reparses and rehashes inputs after preflight. Performance and whole-process limits remain unmeasured.
Scalar refusal combines invalid source syntax and unsupported scalar strings; it exposes no more precise cause.
Combined-budget refusal combines aggregate bytes, input count and per-capture limits; it exposes no single component cause.
The raw relation-source interpreter, complete theory closure and mandatory independent proof checking remain separate.
The legacy unguarded entrypoints remain callable. Production consumers are not yet forced to use this new candidate entrypoint.
